senses.gloss: m. (Syr. זרזירא P. Sm. 1156, Ar. zurzur; prob. fr. זור to circle) starling, also (collect.) flock of starlings.
units: <cite ref="Chullin 62a:2">Ḥull. 62ᵃ</cite> <he>להביא את הז׳</he> (Sifra Sh’mini, Par. 3, ch. V <he>הזַרְזִירִים</he>, Ar. <he>רין …</he>) to include the starling (in the genus raven). Ḥull. l. c.; <cite ref="Bava Kamma 92b:13">B. Kam. 92ᵇ</cite> (prov.) <he>לא לחנם הלך ז׳ וכ׳</he> not without cause does the starling follow the raven &c.; <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 65:3">Gen. R. s. 65</cite>, beg.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 65:3">Ib.</cite> <he>עלה ז׳ אחד וכ׳</he> a flock of starlings came to Palestine.—Pl. <he>זַרְזִירִים</he>, <cite ref="G00694"><he>זַרְזִירִין</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 75:4">Gen. R. s. 75</cite> <he>אין שני ז׳ וכ׳</he> two flocks of starlings cannot sleep on one board (two nations cannot rule at the same time).
